New York City is already one of the most interesting places on earth to photograph.

Now throw in Halloween, thousands of ridiculous costumes, a parade through Greenwich Village, and an entire city that collectively decides to lose its mind for a night.

Absolute perfection.

Every year I get the opportunity to photograph the NYC Halloween Parade, I'm reminded just how lucky I am to do what I do.

The energy, the creativity, the random conversations with complete strangers. It's everything I love about street photography wrapped into one beautifully chaotic night.

Until next year, NYC. Stay weird.

#VillageHalloweenParade #NYCHalloween2026 #NYCStreetPhotographer #HalloweenInNYC #StreetPortraits

The best part of photographing the NYC Halloween Parade? The people. ALWAYS the people.

Some of these costumes are genuinely insane. The amount of time, creativity, and commitment people put into showing up for one night in New York City is absolutely incredible.

And getting to wander around with my camera, meeting strangers, capturing their personalities, and documenting all of it? That's my kind of Halloween.

Seriously, what a fucking fun night.

Already looking forward to next year.

#NYCHalloween #NYCHalloweenParade #HalloweenStreetPhotography #NYCStreetPhotography #CostumePhotography NewYorkCity FujifilmPhotography TheBaldDudeCo

DAY 4/30. Still doing this whole posting-every-day thing. Somehow.

A little Gatsby, a lot of New York City.

October 10th was one for the books. I had the opportunity to photograph the Great Gatsby Party at @capitalenyc in Chinatown, and what an incredible night.

From the live performances and music to the absolutely insane outfits, every corner of the party felt like stepping into another era. The energy, the fashion, the people, the atmosphere. Everything was just so damn good.

One of my favorite things about photographing events in NYC is getting to capture nights like this, where everyone shows up, goes all out, and becomes part of the experience.

Huge shoutout to @greatgatsbyparty and @capitalenyc for putting together such an unforgettable evening. Already looking forward to the next one!

Photographed by @thebalddude.dng
